thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — wanted to lock on SLO edits + owners before next oncall rotation. I sketched a short proposal below, and a bake plan. Please chime in with concerns.

sam: thanks maya. can you paste the exact SLO deltas?

maya: sure. proposal: p95 latency for /generate: 150ms -> 180ms (temporary 14-day burn-in). p99 stays at current. throughput SLO for batch ingestion: 120req/s/shard -> 100req/s/shard to ease tail queuing. Error-budget alert thresholds unchanged for now. :thinking_face:

lex: sounds reasonable in principle. main ask: run a quick sim over last 30d to estimate error-budget impact.

maya: did a quick query this morning — summary inlined: 
```
30d (current SLO): 12 p95 breach events, total burn 18%
Simulated (new p95=180ms): 4 breach events, burn ~6%
Net: ~67% reduction in p95-triggered burn
```

ops-runbook: noted. I'll capture owners: maya = SLO PR + postmortem note, sam = dashboard + alerts, lex = validation sim + runbook addendum, ben = canary rollout + rollback plan. Target timeline: dashboard/alerts in 48h, canary within 7 days, 14-day bake window.

sam: I'll create a Grafana board: routes /generate and /batch-ingest, p50/p95/p99, 30d retention. Alerts: page on >3 p95 breaches in 24h or >5% error-budget burn in 24h. I'll link the dashboard here when done.

lex: starting the simulation now; will run both live-traffic replay and synthetic tail injection. ETA EOD.

ben: planning canary for Tue 10:00 PT — will coordinate with oncall and have rollback checklist ready. tagging @oncall-bot for reminders.

oncall-bot: Canary scheduled by ben: 1716800000 (Tue 10:00 PT). Reminder set 1h before.

maya: action items recap (short):
- maya: open SLO-change PR + add promotion criteria (temp 14d -> auto-promote if no regression) — due Fri EOD
- sam: dashboard + alerts + runbook links — due in 48h
- lex: simulation artifacts + validation notes — due EOD
- ben: canary schedule + rollback checklist — due before canary start

lex: quick Q — if sim shows edgecases where p99 degrades, do we want to revert the throughput change instead?

maya: good call. decision tree: if p99 increases by >10% relative to baseline during bake, we abort promotion and open an incident triage. We'll keep p99 guard rails in the dashboard.

sam: created dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/r/xyz (working link) — added alert rules. Placing the board in the SLO folder.

ben: assigning myself rollback procedure item. will include steps for immediate traffic cutover and quick model fallback.

maya: perfect. lex, ping me if the sim finds regressions. otherwise we'll run the canary and start the 14-day bake. reconvene after bake window for final decision. :thumbsup:

ben: ack.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for canary start: 1h before (1716796400).

maya: thanks everyone — closing the loop here and will post the PR link once ready.
